verdict.rationale: GitBook advertises an 'AI search' feature and dedicated docs on searching content, and independent community feedback specifically praises GitBook's search as 'fast & accurate' out of the box, supporting the fast+relevant part of the story. However, no evidence explicitly confirms typo-tolerance or details on ranking algorithms/whole-site scope. Missing for 10: explicit typo-tolerance documentation, technical detail on relevance ranking, and independent benchmarking beyond one anecdotal HN comment.
